# Copilot instructions for this repo (JBL110 Innovation & Regulation)

## Purpose
This file provides general guidance for AI agents working in this repository. The repository is a knowledge base for the JBL110 course on Innovation and Regulation.

## Directory Structure & Content
- **`Module_1/` to `Module_5/`**: These directories contain course materials, including lecture notes and mandatory readings for each module.
- **`Exams/`**: Contains mock exams and related materials, such as answer guides.
- **`Quizzes/`**: Contains past quiz content and rationales.
- **`Lecture_Pdfs/`**: Mirrors the module structure and holds lecture slides in PDF format.
- All source content for analysis and generation is in **Markdown (`.md`)** format.

## Conventions
- **Generated Content**: Any new content created by an AI agent should be placed in a `Generated/` subfolder within the relevant directory (e.g., `Module_1/Generated/`, `Exams/Generated/`).
- **Lecture Files**: The primary lecture file for a task will be specified by the user when it is relevant.
- **Citations**: When referencing materials, use in-repo file paths.
